dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Lemon Peppa Steppa is at risk due to behavior and medical concerns. He arrived at the care centers as a stray and has not acclimated well. He has tolerated some handling, occasionally displaying a loose, relaxed body language, and at times presents socially with handlers. During his time at the care cneters he has been highly reluctant to walk, but has allowed to be picked up and carried back to kennel. Recently, Lemon Peppa Steppa has started grabbing the leash while growling, and attempting to pull it into kennel when attempting to return him to his kennel. Medically, Lemon Peppa Steppa has CIRDC with mild brachycephalic syndrome. As well he has congential deformity affecting his front legs (the right one more notable) that will need follow up with orthopedic specialist.

Lemon Peppa Steppa was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. During his time at the care center he has been highly reluctant to walk, needing to be carried, and has shown some fearful and defensive behavior with handling, tensing and escalating to growling when being examined in his medical and when being returned to his kennel. In calmer environments with a slow approach, he has shown social behavior with handlers. Due to the behavior observed at the care center, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Lemon Peppa Steppa
